surface-dark.displayName: Always-dark surface (header, footer, hero, Sold pill)

display.purpose: Titles at 800 with -0.02em tracking; wordmark. Archivo 700 for emphasis.

body.purpose: All running copy, labels, and controls. Inputs are always 16px or larger.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing curve used anywhere in the UI, per CLAUDE.md Animation timing.

motion.name: duration-default-max
motion.purpose: Ceiling for all UI animation: hover, press, toggles, sheets, the photo viewer, lists, navigation. Reduced motion swaps movement for a short fade.

motion.name: duration-focal-entrance
motion.purpose: Exception for a rare focal entrance on a marketing surface only (e.g. listing-page hero). Never on repeated interactions.

glass.darkExtra: brightness(0.75) on dark glass, so light text keeps 4.5:1 over white photos
glass.highContrast: solid var(--surface) with a visible ink border
glass.rule: One .glass utility in app/globals.css is the only floating treatment.

allowedUses: Active admin tab label and icon
Error icon and error text on the page background (never on a dark-mode card)
redRules.budget: Red stays at or under 5% of the visual weight of any screen.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink fill with inverse text, fully rounded. Ink, not red, in both themes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--ink-inverse); height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; border: none; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Grouped-row input: label left, 16px native control right, 52px row on a surface group. Standalone fields use a fill background.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; margin-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); } .ds-input { min-height: 0; flex: 1; min-width: 0; text-align: right; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: none; font: 400 16px/1.5 Barlow, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Control
components.description: A floating round control or pill: tab bar, form bars, photo buttons, WhatsApp pill. Always the .glass utility.
components.css: .glass { background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow); backdrop-filter: var(--glass-filter); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--glass-filter); } .ds-glass-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

narrative.overview: A phone-first car showcase and its admin app, styled after native iOS: a soft grey page, white cards, ink type and floating glass controls. The theme follows the system light or dark setting, with no toggle. Signal red is an accent with a fixed list of uses; status never reads as red.
keyCharacteristics: Two typefaces, one role each: Archivo for display (800 titles, -0.02em tracking), Barlow for everything else.
One accent colour, signal red, limited to the uses in redRules.allowedUses.
Flat cards on a grey page; one glass treatment for everything that floats.
Always-dark surface (#141414 in both themes) for the public header, footer, landing hero and the Sold pill.

rules.name: The Red Rule
rules.body: Signal red appears only on the uses in extensions.redRules.allowedUses. Primary buttons are ink filled. Status indicators are never red. Red stays at or under 5% of the visual weight of any screen.

rules.name: Red Text Placement
rules.body: Red error text sits on the page background, where it keeps 4.5:1 in both themes. Inside a card, errors use ink text with a red icon, because dark-mode red on the dark card is under 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A shadow appears only on a floating/overlay element (glass controls, a dropdown panel, a sheet) or a toggle control, never as general card or button styling.

rules.name: Glass Fallbacks
rules.body: Glass becomes a solid surface under prefers-reduced-transparency, and solid with an ink border under prefers-contrast: more.

dos: Do use the tokens in colorMeta, in both themes, and nothing else.
Do use the one .glass utility for anything that floats.
Do keep red to the uses in redRules.allowedUses.
Do keep every input at 16px or larger and every tap target at 44px or larger.
Do keep all UI animation at or under 300ms using cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).
donts: Don't use signal red for status indicators (Reserved/Sold), primary buttons, or red text on a dark-mode card.
Don't introduce a third typeface; Archivo and Barlow cover every documented use.
Don't add shadows to cards or buttons as a default treatment; shadows are reserved for floating/overlay elements only.
Don't use text-muted or ink-3 on glass; both fail 4.5:1 there.
